functions.functionName: Get Display Name for Current Weather · 𝖴𝖣𝖶
functions.description: Finds a descriptor for the current weather state on Ultra Dynamic Weather. Note, this is not directly related to the weather settings objects informing the current state. For example, if the weather is transitioning from Clear Skies to Overcast, this function will not output either of those states in the middle of that transition. Instead, it would output something reasonable for the in between state like Partly Cloudy.

functions.functionName: Get Wind Speed in Real Units · 𝖴𝖣𝖶
functions.description:
Gets the wind speed from UDW approximated as real world units (knots, MPH, KPH)
The input Knots at Wind Intensity 10 can be used to recalibrate this calculation higher or lower, if you've configured wind forces and effects to represent a different level of wind at a Wind Intensity value of 10.
The input Factor Wind Gusts applies the wind gust multiplier. See the documentation on Wind Gusts for information on that.
